description: Test SSRF with localhost bypass variants. Sends 10+ representations of localhost (127.0.0.1, 0, decimal, hex, IPv6, etc.) to check if the server fetches internal resources. Returns results array with variant, payload_url, status, length, different_from_baseline per attempt. Side effects: May cause the target server to make internal requests.
